title: Freshness of the public-fallback floor

options.name: Keep current behaviour: quote, wait for the approve, swap with the old floor

options.name: Re-quote right before the swap
options.behavior_impact: The floor matches the pool at send time.

recommendation: requote-after-approve (or remove the approve from the path, card OD-37).

behavior_impact: Decides whether the guaranteed exit uses a current floor.
